title: Reliance jumps 11.6% on record profit, lifting Nifty 1.68% to 23,440 as oil cools
dek: One stock did about half the work. Reliance's best day since April 2020, a 3% drop in Brent and foreign buying pushed the Sensex up 1,233 points to start Diwali week.
card: Nifty +387.70 at 23,440.80, Sensex +1,233.25 at 75,692.78. Reliance +11.6%, Oil & Gas index +5.95%, but IT and pharma slipped.
sources: IIFL: Closing Bell, Nifty surges 1.68% to 23,441 as Reliance rallies 11.6%
